reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS signups,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE split_part(email_domain, '.', -1) = lower(country_code)) AS local_signups,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE split_part(email_domain, '.', -1) = lower(country_code)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS local_pct
FROM signups
WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code
alternatives:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS signups,
       SUM(CASE WHEN email_domain LIKE '%.' || lower(country_code) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS local_signups,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN email_domain LIKE '%.' || lower(country_code) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS local_pct
FROM signups
WHERE CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(user_id) AS signups,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN upper(split_part(email_domain, '.', -1)) = country_code THEN user_id END) AS local_signups,
       ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN upper(split_part(email_domain, '.', -1)) = country_code THEN user_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(user_id), 1) AS local_pct
FROM signups
WHERE signup_ts >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC

solver.query:
SELECT country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS signups,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(regexp_extract(email_domain, '[^.]*$')) = lower(country_code)) AS local_signups,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(regexp_extract(email_domain, '[^.]*$')) = lower(country_code)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS local_pct
FROM signups
WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC
